name: Short natural dissolve
summary: A brief cross dissolve centred on an existing edit point, built from available source handles.
mediaPrerequisites: two adjacent clips butt-joined at the cut
unused source beyond the cut on both sides to serve as handles
refusalConditions: insufficient handle on either side — the edit point must not move to make room
qualityChecks: the locked edit point does not move
handles are sufficient on both sides
the transition stays centred on the cut
failureModes: overlapping the clips, which is DTD-valid and silently re-flowed by Final Cut
consuming handle the user needed elsewhere

provenance.claim: Final Cut transition movement depends on available media handles
the cross dissolve construction requires a real effect resource, a filter-video reference, offset at cut minus duration/2, and butt-joined clips

validation.notes: Generalized emitter admitted 2026-08-07. A package generated from plan values imported without error and returned intact: transition offset 7s, duration 1s, all four filter-video params byte-identical, the Cross Dissolve UID preserved, no enabled=0, and the clips still butt-joined at 22500/3000s with 15 frames of handle on the incoming side. Final Cut added its own FFAudioTransition companion, the same behaviour the original probe showed. Not established: edge-dragging, durations other than 1s, and stills as dissolve inputs.
verifiedOn: clip-a.mov and clip-b.mov colour bars, 8s each
